entry.title: New: Disk Audit
entry.summary: Disk-usage audit for dsh data directories: total size, per-directory breakdown, largest files, oversized-file warnings (session logs can hit hundreds of MB) and cleanup suggestions. CLI + agent-callable disk_audit tool with dsh-disk-audit/v1 reports. Exact install spec: dsh-disk-audit. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: listed.
